shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed 's#"'^./##'"' | sort | head -200"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- src files ---\\n' && find src -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,200p' {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '\\n--- docs dirs ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -type d -name docs -o -type f -name INDEX.md | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -maxdepth 2 -type d -iname '*Dropdown*' -o -type d -iname '*Menu*' | sort; printf '\\n--- index exports dropdown ---\\n'; rg -n \"DropdownMenu\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.js | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '\\n--- MenuItemProps ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,220p'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'"
